tea.changed: Nov 11: Students staged a midnight protest in Rajendranagar demanding a police case against the university Vice-Chancellor over sexual harassment allegations.

summary: Students at Professor Jayashankar Telangana State Agricultural University staged a midnight protest in Rajendranagar, Hyderabad, demanding that police register a case against Vice-Chancellor Professor Aldas Janaiah. The protest followed accusations by an assistant professor that the Vice-Chancellor sexually harassed her and threatened her career. Protesters raised slogans and alleged that the police failed to provide an acknowledgment receipt after a complaint was submitted at the station. The Telangana State Women's Commission issued notices to the Vice-Chancellor in connection with the case. Vice-Chancellor Professor Aldas Janaiah dismissed the allegations as false, claiming in a letter to the Director General of Police that the complainant was acting out of vindictiveness and was likely instigated by disgruntled elements within the university.
